description: Verify whether a quotation actually occurs in the Cyber Library corpus and return the exact passage, book, chapter, permanent chunk_id and citation. When to use: before citing a quotation, to catch model hallucination, or to ground a claim in a verifiable source. Do not use: to find a book by title (cyberlibrary_search_books) or to read a chapter (cyberlibrary_get_chapter). Matching is exact substring first, then fuzzy (>=90% of the quote). Returns: {quote, verified, match_type, best_score, matches[{chunk_id, score, title, chapter, para, citation, url, license}], corpus_version}.

lang.description: Optional language filter, e.g. zh-cn, en.

slug.description: Optional book slug to restrict the search.

name: cyberlibrary_verify_quote
